subject: Audience gating, registration validation, and live captions — June dry run
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, ON24 Rehearsal Team <rehearsal@on24.com>, Zoom Account Rep <zoomsales@zoom.us>, Bright Events Producer <sara@brightevents.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audience gating, registration validation, and live captions — June dry run

Team,

Quick plan for the June 15 dry run (rehearsal window we discussed): primary goals are to validate that registration gating/segmentation works for partner vs. direct signups, ensure the registration form enforces the new mandatory fields, and confirm live captions/CCP routing for the broadcast.

What I need from each group:
- ON24: confirm you can create two gated registration paths (Partner / General) and return the exact field names so Diego can map them into Pardot. Also confirm the rehearsal room link and when we can enable captions.
- Zoom rep: we may route the webinar via Zoom->ON24 RTMP for the panel segment. Please confirm RTMP handshake/encoder settings (bitrate, keyframe interval) and whether we need a secondary stream for captions.
- Bright Events (Sara): confirm you can run the encoder test 10:00–10:20 PDT on June 15 (we'll be live to stage then).
- Diego: can you add the hidden join_source field for internal lead-scoring? We also need the registration form to require: company, role, country, and a 2nd factor checkbox for recording permissions (GDPR opt-in).

Attachments: webinar_registration_spec_v3.pdf (fields + gating rules), ccp_live_caption_test_script.txt (captioning test steps), on24_rehearsal_checklist.docx.

Schedule proposal (all PDT):
- 09:00 — platform smoke check (internal)
- 10:00 — encoder/RTMP test (Bright Events + Zoom + ON24)
- 11:00 — caption vendor join + caption routing test
- 14:00 — full run-through with panel (short)

Please reply with confirmations and any blocking items. If ON24/Zoom need different time windows, suggest them.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference

From: ON24 Rehearsal Team <rehearsal@on24.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Bright Events Producer <sara@brightevents.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Audience gating, registration validation, and live captions — June dry run

Hi Hannah / team,

Thanks — we can support two distinct registration paths (Partner & General) and will expose the following field keys for mapping: reg_path, company_name, job_title, country, recording_consent (boolean), join_source (hidden). Please confirm exact labels you want on the public form; keys above are what will arrive via the webhook.

Rehearsal room: https://on24.rehearsal/onboard/room-6632 (open for tests starting 06/15 08:00 PDT).

Captions: ON24 supports live captions via Zoom integration or via an external caption stream (CEA-708/608). For quickest turnaround we recommend using Zoom's live captioning integration tied into the webinar broadcast — that will surface captions in both the player and in the post-event transcript. If you prefer a vendor RTP/RTMP feed for captions, we can accept a secondary RTMP input — you'll need to coordinate with your encoder vendor.

RTMP/Encoder notes (for Zoom->ON24 flow):
- RTMP ingest URL / stream key to be provided at the start of the test (we'll rotate keys for rehearsal).
- Recommended video bitrate: 2500–3500 kbps; keyframe: 2s; audio: 128 kbps, 48 kHz.
- If you send a secondary RTMP for captions, please use a different stream key and label it cc_stream.

We've attached a short rehearsal checklist (on24_rehearsal_checklist.docx) with the exact webhook payload sample and our expected field names. We'll hold 10:00–10:30 PDT for the encoder test but can flex if the Zoom team requests a different slot.

Regards,
ON24 Rehearsal Team

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 13:20:47 -0700
Subject: Re: Audience gating, registration validation, and live captions — June dry run

Thanks ON24 — sounds good. A few implementation notes from the ops side: 

- I'll map ON24 keys to our marketing platform like this: reg_path -> interest_segment, company_name -> account_name, job_title -> title, recording_consent -> recording_opt_in, join_source -> join_source_internal.
- Proposal: make recording_consent a required checkbox on the form (text: "I consent to session recording and post-event access for product demo purposes"). Legal has okayed that wording for US/CA; for EU registrants we'll show an additional GDPR consent modal during registration.
- For partner gating: ON24 can set a required partner_code field for the Partner path. If partner_code present, map lead.owner = partner_sales_queue. Marissa, can you confirm the partner_code format (we typically use PART-XXX).
- Encoder test: confirmed with Bright Events for 10:00 PDT on 6/15. I'll stand by to verify the webhook payload and check that join_source populates correctly in the test webhooks.

I'll upload a small test payload to the Drive folder before the 10:00 slot so ON24 can validate the webhook example.

- Diego
Technical Events Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Bright Events Producer <sara@brightevents.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:08:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Audience gating, registration validation, and live captions — June dry run

Quick update from production: our captioning vendor (LiveText) will join the 11:00 slot to test live-caption ingestion. They prefer Zoom's live caption API but can fall back to an RTMP caption stream if necessary.

Note on credentials: Zoom sent an example payload with the connection snippet — forwarding the snippet below (sensitive fields redacted):

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Zoom Account Rep <zoomsales@zoom.us>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 07:50:12 -0700
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: RTMP details for Redwood rehearsal

Hi Mateo,

Please use the following sample for RTMP setup (REDACTED keys below). We'll issue a per-session stream key for rehearsal:
RTMP URL: rtmp://ingest.zoom.us/live
Stream key: z_****_REDACTED

Let us know if you need help with encoder settings.

Best,
Zoom Sales
-----

I'll coordinate with LiveText to attempt both Zoom captions and an RTMP caption stream to validate that ON24 player surfaces captions correctly.

See you at 10:00 for encoder tests.

— Mateo
Senior Events Producer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, ON24 Rehearsal Team <rehearsal@on24.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audience gating, registration validation, and live captions — June dry run

All good from GTM/partners side — partner_code format PART-<3digits> (e.g., PART-042). Diego, use partner_sales_queue as owner mapping when partner_code is present.

Recording permission copy looks fine; one small tweak to the GDPR modal for EU: add a line "You can request deletion of your data at any time via privacy@redwood.com." Diego, please add that for EU registrants only.

Post-event retention: we will keep the recording internally for 12 months and publish an edited clip to our site for 90 days. ON24, please confirm that the post-event export can be set to 90-day public access and that we can request a full recording archive separately.

Thanks everyone — final ask: once ON24 confirms the captions routing (Zoom captions vs RTMP caption stream), reply-all and we will lock the runbook.

Marissa
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
